Markets.title: Madhusudan Kela’s portfolio: 7 stocks rally up to 135% in CY26
Markets.summary: As of August 14, investor Madhusudan Kela’s disclosed portfolio of 19 stocks was valued at approximately Rs 2,665 crore. Performance among his holdings was sharply divergent, with seven stocks rallying between 10% and 135% and five declining between 15% and 30% in 2026.

Markets.title: Bitcoin near $63,000 as weaker ETF demand and cancelled SEC meeting dampen crypto sentiment
Markets.summary: Bitcoin hovered near $63,000 as declining ETF demand and a cancelled SEC meeting weighed on the cryptocurrency market. Consequently, Bitcoin and Ethereum prices fell, while the global crypto market capitalization dropped by 0.4%.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty consolidation to continue says Sudeep Shah; gives Tata Motors, Lenskart, Honasa strategy
Markets.summary: The Nifty is expected to remain in a consolidated range between 24,150 and 24,600 amid falling volatility and strong support from Put writing. Analyst Sudeep Shah recommends maintaining a positive outlook on the PSU bank, auto, defense, and chemical sectors while providing specific strategies for Tata Motors, Lenskart, and Honasa.

Markets.title: IPO rush: 5 companies to raise Rs 5,499 crore next week; Shiprocket, 4 others to list
Markets.summary: Five companies will raise Rs 5,499.32 crore through initial public offerings between August 17 and 21. Additionally, five recently completed IPOs, including Shiprocket, are scheduled to list next week.

Markets.title: Concurrent Losers: 11 stocks decline for 5 consecutive sessions
Markets.summary: The Sensex dropped 490 points over a five-session period ending August 14, while 23 BSE 500 stocks declined daily. Eleven of those stocks fell by more than 5%, led by Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Physicswallah, and Techno Electric & Engineering.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk| Where is the value? Sachin Bajaj favours financials, healthcare, capex plays
Markets.summary: Axis Max Life CIO Sachin Bajaj is optimistic about Indian equities due to recovering earnings, moderate valuations, and strong domestic flows. He recommends investing in financials, healthcare, capital goods, digital platforms, and manufacturing, while avoiding expensive stocks.

Geo-Political.title: Rescuers search for survivors of powerful Indonesia earthquake
Geo-Political.summary: Rescuers are searching for survivors following a powerful earthquake in Indonesia that destroyed hundreds of buildings. Officials report that the disaster has killed 47 people and a rapid assessment of the damage is underway.

Geo-Political.title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta, reports say
Geo-Political.summary: Morocco detained dozens of migrants attempting to cross the border into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta on Saturday. Security forces increased their presence in the area following social media rumors about a planned mass crossing.

Geo-Political.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon resulted in eleven deaths, according to local authorities. The Israeli military stated the strikes targeted Hezbollah infrastructure following earlier actions against its soldiers.

Geo-Political.title: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne
Geo-Political.summary: Liechtenstein has changed its succession laws to permit women to ascend the throne. This announcement was made during the national day of the European principality, which has a population of 44,000.

Geo-Political.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
Geo-Political.summary: Qatar has denied capturing three Iranian pilots who Iran claims were held after Qatari forces downed two fighter jets. This alleged incident reportedly occurred at the start of the ongoing US-Iran war.

Geo-Political.title: Multiple suspects at large after five shot at Virginia State University, police say
Geo-Political.summary: Five people were shot outside a residence hall at Virginia State University early Saturday morning. Police report that multiple suspects remain at large following the incident.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best industry option. This organic recommendation occurred without the creator using paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps creators produce digital media. It also offers tools for users to share and monetize their creations.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Price pressures, youth unemployment, chairman exit
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation features data-driven charts analyzing recent stories reported by Mint. The insights cover topics including price pressures, youth unemployment, and a chairman's exit.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation eased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation in primary articles and manufactured products accelerated during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% year-on-year to $173.78 billion.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation decreased to 3.4% year-on-year in July, matching analyst expectations. This moderation in price increases could give the Federal Reserve more flexibility regarding future interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, compounded by risks from elevated global oil prices.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the twentieth consecutive year due to strong economic growth prospects. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

India.title: As Sukhbir Badal Recovers, Harsimrat Steps Up: Woman Leading Akalis' Fight
India.summary: Harsimrat Kaur Badal has taken charge of leading the Shiromani Akali Dal's political efforts while Sukhbir Badal recovers from an attack. Sukhbir Badal was attacked at a gurdwara in Nanded, Maharashtra.

India.title: Centre's Auditor CAG Flags E Coli In Drinking Water Across Railway Stations
India.summary: India's national auditor, the CAG, found that drinking water at multiple railway stations failed bacteriological tests, including tests for E. coli, during the 2022-23 and 2023-24 periods. The unsatisfactory water quality results were identified across several railway zones over the two financial years.

India.title: Shoutout To Gen Z, Warning For Rivals In Vijay's First Independence Day Speech
India.summary: During his first Independence Day speech, actor-turned-politician Vijay warned his rivals that any conspiracies or forces working against his future government would be defeated. He also gave a special shoutout to Generation Z, signaling their importance to his political movement in Tamil Nadu.

India.title: Himanta Sarma Urges Assam Settlers To List Assamese As Mother Tongue During Census
India.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Sarma urged settlers in the state to list Assamese as their mother tongue during the upcoming census. He stated that residents of the Bengali-majority Barak Valley and tribal groups are free to choose their own mother tongue.

India.title: Jharkhand Protestors Announce Gherao Of Hemant Soren's House On August 20
India.summary: Protesters in Jharkhand plan to surround Chief Minister Hemant Soren's house on August 20. They also intend to burn effigies of Soren and Rahul Gandhi across 24 districts to protest the ruling alliance's failure to meet their demands.

India.title: Uttarakhand Tunnel Workers Say They Flagged Water Leak, Got No Reply
India.summary: Eight workers died after a tunnel in Chamoli, Uttarakhand, flooded. The victims stated they had reported a water leak in the tunnel prior to the incident but received no response.

General.title: Major incidents across UK putting firefighters under 'incredible pressure', fire chief says
General.summary: Fire chiefs report that major incidents and blazes in areas like Stourbridge, Sandwell, and Pershore are putting firefighters across England and Wales under extreme pressure. Multiple fire services are responding to these severe emergencies as the situation unfolds.

General.title: Jason Arday death 'tragedy on so many levels' says PM
General.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer called the death of former Cambridge professor Jason Arday a tragedy on many levels. Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham described the situation as a really sad and sorry state of affairs.

General.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake kills at least 47 in Indonesia
General.summary: A powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake has killed at least 47 people on the Indonesian island of Flores. A search and rescue operation is currently underway to find survivors.

General.title: Met Police apologises for data breach involving alleged Al Fayed victims
General.summary: The Metropolitan Police apologized for a data breach involving people who signed up for updates regarding allegations against Mohamed Al Fayed. Scotland Yard accidentally included all subscribers in the email list for the monthly update.

General.title: Reform UK plan would overhaul welfare system with £50bn in savings
General.summary: Reform UK will release a 50-page manifesto on Monday detailing proposed overhauls to the welfare system. The party aims to achieve £50 billion in savings through these changes if it comes to power.

General.title: Thousands of Bonnie Tyler fans line the streets as coffin taken to Swansea home
General.summary: Thousands of fans lined the streets of Swansea as the coffin of singer Bonnie Tyler was brought to her home. Tyler passed away last month in a Portuguese hospital.
